## Names

<a id="figure_f77_parts"></a>
### [`figure_f77_parts`](../../../src/judge_sprites_d000.asm#L6) `$D000`

*data*

VIC pointers $40-$42: frame 77, a small standing figure (slots top left, middle left, bottom left; bottom middle is $4f). No animation script uses frames 77 and 78, so no run shows them. The blocks $d000-$d27f are the v1 blocks $c980-$cbff (v1 pointers $26-$2f) in the same order.

- **Written by:** [`irq_frame_start`](sprite_mux_plan.md#irq_frame_start) [`$364D`](../../../src/sprite_mux_plan.asm#L547)

<a id="figure_f78_parts"></a>
### [`figure_f78_parts`](../../../src/judge_sprites_d000.asm#L72) `$D0C0-$D1FF`

*data*

VIC pointers $43-$47: frame 78 of the small figure. Frames 77 and 78 are the v1 frames 68 and 69 with new part numbers.

<a id="judge_flag_sprite"></a>
### [`judge_flag_sprite`](../../../src/judge_sprites_d000.asm#L274) `$D440-$D47F`

*data*

Flag of the judge (sprite 7, pointer $51 at $1f9f). judge_show_winner colours it with the winner colour: X+1, white or red. v1 had the same block unused at $d500.
